title: Examining the Role of Relationship Alignment in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differences in the semantic tones (e.g., emotional support, self-disclosure, insult) of LLM-generated comments by explicitly including the commenter's and poster's gender in the prompt and comparing the outputs to human baselines using linear mixed-effects regression models.

Evaluating differences in the semantic tones of LLM-generated comments by explicitly including the commenter's and poster's age in the prompt and comparing the dependency of the generated outputs to human baselines.

Measuring how varying levels of friendship tie strength (close friends, non-close friends, strangers) included in the prompt affect the semantic tone of LLM-generated comments, and assessing whether the model over-indexes on this social context compared to human behavior.
